release_notes: **Data-driven regime calibration**: regime classifier thresholds (realized-vol, VIX delta, USDINR, crude, VIX-RV spread cutoffs) are now derived yearly from historical data via `broker/regime_calibrate.py` and loaded from `regime_calibration.json`, replacing hardcoded cutoffs. The FII/DII net-flow risk-appetite signal (NSE endpoint had no date param, blocking backtests) is replaced with a VIX-RV spread proxy. Notifier now formats composer-engine multi-leg exits and long-leg exits (previously only the strangle and LIB V1 shapes were handled), with a new `long_exit` notify event. New regime API endpoint.
